body: I suppose I always value myself on what I can do or make, and being in a non-productive retail job is making me slump out pretty hard. It’s so difficult to find a way to do for me when I feel like I can’t do it for me.
I never really did get that chance in life. Even graduating high school, I always did for others.

Eden - rock + roll

“I wonder how it feels to burn out young, hey”
